messages:
incident-bot: P1 alert — elevated generation latency in eu-central-1 affecting hosted inference. Pager: @ali-oncall. Incident created 4351239876.
ali-oncall: on it, acknowledging. spinning up additional routing and checking GPU queue depths.
sophie.ops: starting a quick status page initial draft. pasting below — please give thumbs or edits fast.
sophie.ops: ```Initial status update (DRAFT)
Impact: Some requests to model endpoints in eu-central-1 may see higher-than-normal generation latency and intermittent timeouts.
Customer impact: Customers may experience slowed responses for text generation and streaming. Embeddings unaffected.
Scope: Hosted API (eu-central-1). Estimated affected percentage: ~12% of requests.
Mitigation: Traffic is being routed to healthy pools and autoscaling is in progress. Engineers are restarting a problematic GPU node group.
Next update: 30 mins or when we have a root cause.```
jordan-platform: technical check — we saw a KV-cache thrash causing long tail token generation in fastgen-2. Root cause likely abrupt memory fragmentation after a rollout.
lee-comm: rewording suggestion for public copy: avoid technical terms like KV-cache. propose: "an internal service degradation causing slower generation for a subset of requests". also add CTA: "No action required; we will post updates."
maria-legal: quick note — do not mention percentages unless we're confident. Replace "~12%" with "a subset of requests" unless ops confirms. Also avoid saying "timeouts" as a data-loss implication.
sophie.ops: ack. updating draft now. new draft below.
sophie.ops: ```Initial status update (DRAFT)
Impact: Some requests to text generation endpoints in eu-central-1 may experience slower responses.
Customer impact: A subset of requests may be delayed; there is no evidence of data exposure or loss.
Scope: Hosted API (eu-central-1).
Mitigation: Traffic is being routed to healthy capacity pools and autoscaling is running. Engineers are performing node restarts and monitoring recovery.
Next update: in 30 minutes or earlier if resolved.```
mika-devex: add link to runbook? runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/latency-gen — helps with traceability in the status page internal note.
ali-oncall: can someone add the following internal note below the public copy: "Internal: affected service fastgen-2, mitigation steps: cache warm, node-restart, rollback candidate prepared." keep internal-only.
sophie.ops: added internal note in ops-only field. final check: maria? lee? jordan?
maria-legal: good to go with current wording. keep "subset" language.
jordan-platform: tech ok. removing any absolute numbers.
lee-comm: ok for publish. small tweak: change phrase "monitoring recovery" -> "monitoring for recovery" for tone.
sophie.ops: done. preparing to publish — steps: 1) copy final draft to status.redwood.io draft UI 2) set visibility public 3) schedule immediate publish 4) post slack thread with link. I will handle.
ali-oncall: tagging me when published so I can update oncall channel and include timeframe estimates.
sophie.ops: publishing now. pinging once live.
sophie.ops: Published initial statuspage update: https://status.redwood.io/incident/rc-2026-eu-gen-latency. slack note posted to #customers.
ali-oncall: Confirmed. routing controls show traffic shift to dedicated pools is in effect; tail latencies dropping.
incident-bot: update: mitigation progress logged.
lee-comm: drafting customer notification email/notice to go with the status page link — will share now.
lee-comm: ```Customer note (draft)
We're aware some customers in EU may see slower AI response times. Our engineers are actively mitigating this; no action required on your side. We'll post updates on the status page.```
maria-legal: fine. avoid "your side" -> "any action on your part." small edit please.
lee-comm: updated. thanks.
jordan-platform: recovery looks promising, but we should keep rolling updates every 20–30 mins until stable.
ali-oncall: agreed. I'll post a technical follow-up in 25m with perf metrics and then final resolve.
sophie.ops: next update posted (ops note): added CPU/GPU queue graphs to internal status. link: https://internal.redwood/ops/status/4351239876
incident-bot: automated follow-up: no customer-visible change required for now.
ali-oncall: 25m update — tail p99 latency reduced by ~60% after node restarts. still some residual background retries.
sophie.ops: posting intermediate status update to public page: "Mitigation in progress; performance improving. We continue to monitor"
lee-comm: sent customer email to affected customers list with status page link.
maria-legal: confirm no regulatory customers impacted; fine.
ali-oncall: final: memory fragmentation patch deployed to a canary and rolled to remaining pools; monitoring shows stable latencies across eu region for 15m.
jordan-platform: confirm rollback not needed. can mark resolved after 30m stable window.
sophie.ops: preparing resolved notice draft.```Resolved status update (DRAFT)
Impact: Previously, some requests to text generation endpoints in eu-central-1 experienced higher-than-normal latency.
Resolution: The issue was resolved after a memory-management patch and targeted node restarts. Traffic was routed to healthy capacity during mitigation.
Customer impact: A subset of requests may have been delayed. No data exposure or loss was observed.
Time to resolution: ~1h 10m.
Follow-up: Postmortem will be published with root cause and remediation steps in 72 hours.```
sophie.ops: publishing resolved now.
sophie.ops: Resolved update published: https://status.redwood.io/incident/rc-2026-eu-gen-latency/resolved
ali-oncall: Verified customer-facing status is updated and internal postmortem ticket created: PM-5432. Thanks everyone for quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
lee-comm: will coordinate postmortem summary with product comms and customer success.
mika-devex: adding runbook improvements to the postmortem checklist.
maria-legal: closing from legal side. no action needed.
incident-bot: incident rc-2026-eu-gen-latency resolved at 4351243200. Postmortem assigned.
ali-oncall: closing thread. if anyone needs link to postmortem draft, ping me.
